gloss: to execute; to carry out; to put into practice

definitions.gloss: to execute; to carry out; to put into practice
definitions.explanation: To actually do something that was planned or decided. Emphasizes taking concrete action rather than just thinking or talking about it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{実行|じっこう}する。
⟦{約束|やくそく}した→約束する：05643_yakusokusuru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧{実行|じっこう}し⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Always follow through on what you have promised.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}す→移す：10122_utsusu⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: We plan to put into action what was decided at the meeting starting next week.

notes:
A fundamental verb for expressing the act of carrying something out in practice. Contrasts with merely planning, discussing, or intending to do something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{実行|じっこう}する: to carry out a plan
- ⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}す→移す：10122_utsusu⟧: to put into action
- ⟦{実行|じっこう}{力|りょく}→実行力：08705_jikkouryoku⟧: ability to take action; execution ability
- ⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧⟦{委員|いいん}{会|かい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧: executive committee
- ⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{実行|じっこう}する: to carry out a crime

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遂行|すいこう}する→遂行する：20156_suikousuru⟧: to carry out — more formal; used for duties and missions
- ⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧: to implement — focuses on officially putting a policy or system into effect
- ⟦{実践|じっせん}→実践：08241_jissen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put into practice — emphasizes applying knowledge or theory to real situations
- ⟦{執行|しっこう}する→執行する：25498_shikkousuru⟧: to execute — legal/administrative; carrying out orders, sentences, or duties

REGISTER:
Neutral. Used in both everyday conversation and formal contexts. The noun ⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧ frequently appears in compound words.
